ownership: Official public active sales-tax permit records published through the State of Texas Open Data Portal
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS Socrata API. The official catalog marks the dataset Public Domain, and the Comptroller identifies it as public raw machine-readable open data.
allowed_use: official HTTPS metadata, count, and selected-field API queries
derived business-registry assertions and source-linked relationships
redistribution of aggregate statistics with source attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing an active sales-tax permit as independent proof that an outlet is continuously operating, open to the public, solvent, or compliant with every licensing requirement
representing a source physical address as independently verified or currently occupied
representing this tax-permit source as every Texas or United States business
publishing taxpayer mailing-address fields acquired from the source
publishing record-level natural-person names or possible residential addresses without an approved privacy review
inferring a parent company or cross-source identity without versioned evidence
silently treating PO boxes or invalid ZIP values as physical sites
attribution: Source: Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, Active Sales Tax Permit Holders, via data.texas.gov.
retention: Indefinite for immutable selected-field source and governed normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Aggregate counts may be redistributed with Texas Comptroller attribution, source refresh timestamp, source checksum, provenance, and tax-permit limitations. Record-level normalized data remains local-review-only pending privacy review even though the source catalog marks the dataset Public Domain.
personal_data_handling: Taxpayer and outlet names can identify sole proprietors, and source physical addresses can be residences. Taxpayer mailing-address fields are excluded at query time; selected source and normalized record-level artifacts remain local, while only aggregate coverage is public by default.
